hook: Telangana got *628 mm* of rain against 831 normal. Groundwater fell again
hook_b: Telangana got *628 mm* of rain against 831 normal. Groundwater fell again
tldr: State rain finished at 628 mm vs 831 mm normal; 22 of 33 districts are in deficit.

beats.what: The state got 628 mm against 831 mm normal. 22 districts are in deficit (20% to 50% short) and 11 are in the normal band.
beats.why: Less rain means less recharge, so water tables fell further over the past month.
beats.care: If you depend on a borewell near Vikarabad or Hyderabad's edge, expect weaker yield and plan tanker backup.

sources.title: Telangana's groundwater levels drop further in a month as rain deficit soars

fact: Telangana's groundwater fell again in a month as the monsoon ended *200 mm* short.
twist: Groundwater is lowest in Vikarabad and the Hyderabad periphery, the places that lean on borewells most.
